R2 advertises an external route into OSPF with a Type 2 metric. Which route would be preferred? A. R1's route is preferred because Type 1 metrics take into account the external cost only. B. R1's route is preferred because Type 1 metrics take into account the internal and external cost. C. R2's route is preferred because Type 2 metrics take into account the internal and external cost. D. R2's route is preferred because Type 2 metrics take into account the external cost only.
